body: It has something to do with height: '*'.
Ah thanks for the info. I can confirm, if I change my animation to use a fixed height it works as expected. That also makes sense as to why it was always working on close but not open.

issue.body:
during keyframe building only consider the root element's timelines
for the style setting, so that the states styles (applied with '*')
can be applied correctly

resolves #32133
resolves #28654
